description: Fork of exp588 (1.4344 SoTA, single read_out_lut H=1 dense tph=1536 -> D=384). SINGLE change: read_out_lut uses sparse-scatter output, n_outputs=64 (per-table local), sparse_scatter_n_outputs=D=384. Same NAP=6, tph=1536, single-head selector — each table writes only 64 of D=384 slots and the contributions scatter-add into the full D vector. Identical param/bandwidth reduction as exp589 (37.7M -> 6.29M, 18.87 -> 3.15 Mbits) but different topology: ONE NAP=6 selector + scattered writes vs exp589's 6 INDEPENDENT NAP=6 selectors. Tests whether the per-token routing decision is the load-bearing capacity (single selector keeps routing capacity, sparsity only cuts output capacity).
